messages:
sahil: Quick follow-up from the postmortem re: vendor/auth/model-registry outage. Creating a compact action list with owners + ETAs. Reply here with ack + ETA.

maria: Ack. I'll take registry replication and metadata checksums. Deliver design doc by Tue; PoC in 2 sprints.

alex: I'll own auth fallback: cached JWKS + token-bridge signed by our KMS. PoC by Fri EOD, tests next week.

anne: I'll handle vendor SLA/escalation language and request AE. Draft to legal + sales by Wed.

julie: Ops preference: automatic fallback to local quantized model for public routes with circuit-breaker. I'll build packaging checklist.

ops-oncall: I'll implement cross-region synthetic healthchecks and Grafana panels. Staging by next Tue, prod after 48h stable.

devops-bot: Created tickets: INF-3410 registry-replication (maria), INF-3411 auth-fallback (alex), INF-3412 vendor-runbook (anne), INF-3413 cross-region-synthetics (ops-oncall).

sahil: Action owners noted. Require weekly Jira updates and blockers flagged here prior to infra sync. Also add metrics: auth_fallback_rate and fallback_success_ratio.

maria: Noted. Design will include read-only secondary and checksum backfill plan.

alex: Security note: fallback tokens include fallback_reason claim and short TTL. Will post code snippet when PoC ready.

ops-oncall: Scheduling DR drill next Tue 09:00 PT to exercise these flows. RSVP please.

sahil: Thanks. I'll post daily check-ins until PoCs land. Reopen thread if anything blocks vendor/legal paths.
